title: 第一卷 第7章 起来，干死他们！
content_zh:
“我可是天庆郡陈家之人，你们敢抓我！”

    现场当中，陈昭宁愤怒抬头，一双桃花眼里怒意翻腾。

    “哼，什么天庆郡陈家？这里是天山郡，是我们天山郡守的地盘！”

    一名穿灰衣、留山羊胡须的中年男子冷哼一声。

    他眯着一对三角眼，扫过陈昭宁，眸中精芒闪烁：“你们就是从黑山上逃走的福猪吧？

    胆子不小啊，还敢跑？

    他娘的，还敢在我黑米村杀我的奴隶？

    呵，你们可知，那可是我的财物？”

    说着，他看向一旁抱刀而立的中年男子，立刻堆起讨好的笑容：“多谢姚大人，若不是您，这个有点修为的女子，我们没那么容易将其制服。”

    中年男子一边说着，便将一个黑色袋子塞了过去。

    姚大人看到袋里的十几块月银，紧绷的脸上露出满意之色。

    他瞄了眼陈昭宁，低声道：“她说的或许是真，小心她真是天庆郡陈家之人。”

    “呵呵，姚大人放心，这里是姥姥的地盘，姥姥可不怕什么陈家。”

    “更何况，在这大相帝国统治的天下之中，人族生灵就算成了世家，也得依附帝国，才能苟活不是？”

    “这里什么生灵最低贱？自然是人族。”

    “他陈家可是人族，敢向我们妖族的姥姥发难？”

    山羊胡男子说到这里，满脸鄙夷与不屑。

    他冷笑一声，继续道：

    “姥姥可是杀过一位黄庭道人，据说那人也是陈家的，可最后如何？”

    “姥姥根本不鸟那陈家，照样把那中年人斩杀。”

    闻言，姚大人松了口气。

    陈昭宁怒声大骂：“该死，你们这些人族败类，为虎作伥，不得好死！”

    她又看向那姚大人，厉声斥道：

    “还有你，堂堂人族修士，竟为了苟活，向这群猪狗不如的东西，所组建的朝廷卖命？还叫什么大相帝国？啊呸！”

    “还有，你还帮他们抓人送去无相门做试验？把人当成牲畜屠戮？你不配为人！！”

    听到这话，众人全都冷笑连连，一副看白痴的模样。

    “呵呵，这小丫头还挺泼辣，怪不得姥姥如此看重。”

    姚大人看向陈昭宁，阴笑出声。

    另外两名官差也抱刀冷笑。

    山羊胡男子眸中精光一闪，嘿嘿笑道：“姚大人，这女子性子烈，模样又俊，是个美人胚子。”

    “虽然年纪尚小，毛都还没长齐，可真要玩起来的话，怕不是别有一番滋味。”

    听到这话，姚大人眼睛瞬间亮了。

    另外两名官差也是一样，下意识抓了抓腰带，露出不怀好意的神色。

    陈昭宁脸色骤变！

    山羊胡男子继续怂恿：“姚大人，这可是千载难逢的机会，难道不想尝尝千年世家大小姐的滋味？”

    这话一出，姚大人彻底意动。

    山羊胡带来的二十多人，眼中全都精光暴涨。

    这种事轮不到他们，但能在旁围观，也是一出令人热血喷涌的好戏。

    若是几位大人心情好，让他们排队轮流上，也不是没可能。

    “行，谁让她敢骂咱们？”

    姚大人心中燥热，盯着陈昭宁的小脸，小腹一阵邪火翻腾。

    他扫了一眼身侧的同僚，淡淡的道：“你们在旁边排队！”

    这话落下，顿时引起了一大片欢呼声。

    他的两名同僚，更是兴奋的上前，抓住陈昭宁的手臂，将她强行摁在一旁的木板车上。

    姚大人狞声一笑，伸手便去解腰带。

    “啊……该死……你……你们都该死！！”
content_en:
"I am from the Chen family in Tianqing County. How dare you arrest me!"

    At the scene, Chen Zhaoning raised his head angrily, his peach blossom eyes filled with anger.

    "Hmph, what is the Chen family in Tianqing County? This is Tianshan County, and it is the territory of our Tianshan County Governor!"

    A middle-aged man in gray clothes and a goatee snorted coldly.

    He squinted his triangular eyes and glanced at Chen Zhaoning, his eyes flashing: "You are the lucky pigs who escaped from the Black Mountain, right?

    You are so courageous, how dare you run?

    Damn it, you still dare to kill my slaves in my black rice village?

    Oh, do you know that that is my property? "

    As he said that, he looked at the middle-aged man standing beside him holding a knife, and immediately put on a flattering smile: "Thank you, Mr. Yao. If it weren't for you, this woman with some cultivation, we wouldn't be able to subdue her so easily."

    As the middle-aged man spoke, he stuffed a black bag into it.

    Master Yao saw a dozen pieces of moon silver in the bag, and his tense face showed a look of satisfaction.

    He glanced at Chen Zhaoning and whispered: "Maybe what she said is true. Be careful, she is really from the Chen family in Tianqing County."

    "Haha, don't worry, Mr. Yao, this is grandma's territory, and grandma is not afraid of the Chen family."

    "What's more, in this world ruled by the Great Prime Minister's Empire, even if human beings become aristocratic families, they have to rely on the empire in order to survive, right?"

    "What creature here is the lowest? Of course it's the human race."

    "The Chen family is from the human race. How dare he attack our demon race's grandma?"

    The goatee man said this with contempt and disdain on his face.

    He sneered and continued:

    "Grandma killed a Taoist from Huang Ting. It is said that that person was also from the Chen family, but what happened in the end?"

    "Grandma didn't care about the Chen family at all, but still killed the middle-aged man."

    Hearing this, Lord Yao breathed a sigh of relief.

    Chen Zhaoning cursed angrily: "Damn it, you scum of the human race, you will not die a good death if you act as a traitor to the tiger!"

    She looked at Master Yao again and scolded:

    "And you, a dignified human monk, actually work for the imperial court established by this group of pigs and dogs in order to survive? What else do you call the Great Chancellor's Empire? Bah!"

    "Also, you help them capture people and send them to Wuxiang Sect for experiments? Treat people like livestock and slaughter them? You are not worthy of being a human being!!"

    Hearing this, everyone sneered, looking like idiots.

    "Haha, this little girl is quite fierce. No wonder grandma thinks so highly of her."

    Master Yao looked at Chen Zhaoning and laughed sinisterly.

    The other two officers also held knives and sneered.

    The goatee man's eyes flashed, and he chuckled: "Master Yao, this woman has a fierce temperament and a handsome appearance. She is a beautiful woman."

    "Although I'm still young and my hair hasn't even grown yet, if I really want to play with it, I'm afraid it won't be that special."

    Upon hearing this, Master Yao's eyes instantly lit up.

    The other two officers did the same. They subconsciously grabbed their belts and showed malicious expressions.

    Chen Zhaoning's expression suddenly changed!

    The man with the goatee continued to encourage: "Master Yao, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Don't you want to taste what it's like to be the eldest lady of a thousand-year-old family?"

    As soon as these words came out, Lord Yao was completely moved.

    The more than twenty people brought by Goatee's eyes all shone brightly.

    This kind of thing is not their turn, but if they can watch from the sidelines, it is also a good show that makes people's blood boil.

    If a few adults are in a good mood, it is not impossible to ask them to line up and take turns.

    "Okay, who dared her to scold us?"

    Master Yao felt hot in his heart, staring at Chen Zhaoning's little face, and an evil fire surged in his lower abdomen.

    He glanced at his colleagues beside him and said calmly: "You guys line up next to me!"

    As soon as these words came out, there was a huge cheer.

    Two of his colleagues stepped forward excitedly, grabbed Chen Zhaoning's arm, and forced her onto a wooden cart nearby.

    Master Yao smiled ferociously and reached out to untie his belt.

    "Ah...damn it...you...you all deserve to die!!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 7 Get up and kill them!
